expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (no files created or changed)

expectations.evidence: The reply says "`/download?file=../../../etc/passwd` resolves to `/etc/passwd`" and that with an absolute path "everything before it is dropped. So `/download?file=/etc/passwd` returns `/etc/passwd` directly."
